regions.region: upper title and central graphical abstract
regions.finding: The graphical abstract is a generic reaction summary with variable X/Y/R groups and an aggregate 66–95% scope range; it is not an individual batch experiment and was not converted into a duplicate experiment record.
Figure 1 contains pharmacologically active background structures A1–A4, while the prose cites prior literature; neither region reports a new experiment from this paper.

unresolved: The generic graphical-abstract structures use variable substituents and were not assigned complete SMILES.

regions.finding: Scheme 1 juxtaposes an established generic Pd(0) allene protocol with the authors' envisioned one-pot assembly, intermediates B/syn-C, and possible D/E/G side paths. It is conceptual/prior-work and mechanistic content, not an experimental batch.

regions.region: upper-right and center-right Table 1 with footnotes
regions.finding: All ten catalyst/ligand/additive optimization rows were extracted independently. Entry 1 preserves the failed 0% NMR result; footnote molecular-sieve loadings, concentration changes, the entry-10 1.5-equivalent imine override, CH2Br2 NMR basis, and 77% isolated yield were structured.
The prose corroborates the solvent, ligand, and molecular-sieve comparisons; it adds no extra fully specified row beyond Table 1. Table 1 entry 10 is reconciled with Table 2 entry 1 on page 3.

unresolved: Main-text optimization rows omit atmosphere, workup, purification, and exact batch-scale quantities; no SI was explicitly associated.

regions.finding: Figure 2 is an ORTEP representation confirming product 3a, not a separate reaction. Its prose supports the optimized batch already represented by the merged Table 1 entry 10/Table 2 entry 1 record.

regions.region: middle-left Table 2 and lower-left selectivity prose
regions.finding: Table 2 entry 1 duplicates the optimized Table 1 entry 10 and was merged across pages. Entries 2–5 are four distinct substrate-scope experiments. The source reports only bridged product 3 by crude 1H NMR and no D/E/G products.

Two distinct TFP controls were extracted from the explicit 70% versus 56% comparison. The statement that 4 Å molecular sieves were not required is retained qualitatively because no separate numerical row or complete conditions are reported. The 75% one-equivalent-aldehyde result is Table 3 entry 1, not a third duplicate control.

All ten allenol substrate-scope rows were extracted independently with R1/R2 labels, time, isolated yield, shared catalyst/ligand/base/solvent/temperature, one equivalent aldehyde, and 0.1 M source concentration. Entries 6–10 retain the reported single-diastereomer observation.
Figure 3 is an ORTEP representation used to establish relative configurations for products 6f–j; it is characterization evidence and not an additional reaction.

unresolved: The two prose ligand controls omit exact catalyst/base loadings, substrate ratio, solvent, temperature, time, and yield measurement basis.
Complex R-group-derived substrate and product structures remain label/drawing based with null SMILES pending chemical review.

regions.finding: All five optically active allenol scope rows were extracted independently with substrate configuration labels, time, isolated yield, product absolute-configuration labels, and product ee. The reported excellent de is qualitative because no numeric de is tabulated.

regions.region: upper-right Figure 4 and adjacent stereochemical prose
regions.finding: Figure 4 is an ORTEP representation of (1R,9R,10R)-6j used for absolute-configuration assignment; it is not an additional reaction. The source states that no reracemization occurred.

Scheme 2 proposes syn-8/anti-8, intermediates 9/10, disfavored 6-prime, and favored 6 to rationalize diastereo- and regioselectivity. These are proposed intermediates/pathways, not batch experiments or independently measured yields.

regions.region: lower conclusion and Supporting Information notice
regions.finding: The conclusion summarizes scope and selectivity without adding experiments. The paper advertises online Supporting Information, but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated in this workspace, so no SI procedures were imported.

unresolved: Starting-material ee values and numeric de values are not given in Table 4; the exact substrate ee was not inferred.
General procedures and spectroscopic data are said to be in SI, but SI association remains unestablished.
